item: 2. TDC’s Lạc Hòa 1 (Sóc Trăng wind farm No. 5, 30 MW) — coordinates and the last 5 MW
proposal: (missing, no change) Lạc Hòa 1 / Sóc Trăng wind farm No. 5 — Vinh Chau–TDC Renewable Energy JSC; coastal flats of Lạc Hòa commune and ward 2, Vĩnh Châu (now Cần Thơ); 30 MW, 6 × 5 MW; 25 MW at COD by 31 Oct 2021, the other 5 MW still “COD dossier not submitted” on 30 Apr 2025. Still no citable coordinates.
note_zh: 仍沒有可引用的座標。新試的路線：(1) OSM API 永珠一帶（105.93–106.20°E、9.26–9.44°N）沒有任何具名的風場、風機或升壓站，只有「Trạm Biến áp 110 kV Vĩnh Châu」；沿海岸有一串 5 部無名風機（9.312–9.331°N、106.021–106.078°E，changeset 179786102，註解只寫「Update」），位置與「樂和社與第 2 坊的海岸灘地」相符，但沒有名稱或業主，不能單獨引用。(2) OpenInfraMap 的越南電廠清單裡沒有這座。(3) GEM 2026-02 也沒有（GEM 的「Lạc Hòa wind farm」一期是 UPC／AC Energy 的和東社那座；「Sóc Trăng 4」是 4 號）。(4) thewindpower.net 的永珠條目註明「Precise localization: No」。最後 5 MW：EVN 2025-04-30 表仍是「未送 COD 文件」，之後沒找到新的追蹤表或公告。
note_en: Still no citable coordinates. New routes tried: (1) the OSM API around Vĩnh Châu (105.93–106.20 E, 9.26–9.44 N) has no named wind farm, turbine or substation except “Trạm Biến áp 110 kV Vĩnh Châu”; a string of 5 unnamed turbines along the shore (9.312–9.331 N, 106.021–106.078 E, changeset 179786102, comment just “Update”) fits “the coastal flats of Lạc Hòa commune and ward 2”, but without a name or operator it cannot be cited on its own. (2) OpenInfraMap’s list of Vietnamese plants does not have it. (3) Nor does GEM 2026-02 (GEM’s “Lạc Hòa wind farm” phase 1 is UPC / AC Energy’s plant in Hòa Đông; “Sóc Trăng 4” is No. 4). (4) thewindpower.net’s Vĩnh Châu entry says “Precise localization: No”. The last 5 MW: EVN’s 30 Apr 2025 tracker still says “COD dossier not submitted”; no later tracker or announcement found.
why: No named OSM feature, no provincial sea-area decision with coordinates found (search returned only other investors’ decisions), no newer EVN tracker located. If someone adds name/operator tags to the 5 shore turbines in OSM, they could be used.

item: 3d. “Dong Hai 1 Offshore wind farm” (GEM, Bạc Liêu, 100 MW) — its point looks like Hòa Bình 2’s site
proposal: (lead, no rule yet) GEM’s approximate point 9.101 N, 105.601 E is about 0.9 km from turbine HB02-08 of the OSM relation “Nhà máy điện gió Hòa Bình 2” (and in Vĩnh Hậu commune by OSM boundaries), whereas Dong Hai 1 is in Long Điền Đông commune of the former Đông Hải district. No citable position for Dong Hai 1 found.
note_zh: GEM 東海 1 號第 1–2 期的概略點離 OSM「和平 2 號」風場的 HB02-08 風機只有約 0.9 km（Nominatim 反查在 Vĩnh Hậu 社，原和平縣），但東海 1 號在原東海縣 Long Điền Đông 社（Báo Đấu thầu）。OSM 在 105.40–105.60°E、8.94–9.10°N 有兩群 26 部的無名風機（平均 9.0638°N、105.5510°E 與 9.0762°N、105.5812°E，changeset 157326799，註解只寫「Wind farm」），其中一群很可能是東海 1 號（26 部），但沒有名稱，不能引用。3a、3b 暫用的就是這個點。
note_en: GEM’s approximate point for Dong Hai 1 phases 1–2 is only about 0.9 km from turbine HB02-08 of the OSM “Hòa Bình 2” wind farm (reverse-geocoded to Vĩnh Hậu commune, former Hòa Bình district), but Dong Hai 1 is in Long Điền Đông commune of the former Đông Hải district (Báo Đấu thầu). OSM has two unnamed 26-turbine groups in 105.40–105.60 E, 8.94–9.10 N (means 9.0638 N, 105.5510 E and 9.0762 N, 105.5812 E; changeset 157326799, comment just “Wind farm”), one of which is very probably Dong Hai 1 (26 turbines), but they carry no name and cannot be cited. 3a and 3b borrow this same point for now.
why: No named OSM feature, Bac Phuong pages give only the commune; 4C Offshore (which GEM cites) is excluded.

item: 4. Song An wind farm (Gia Lai, 46.2 MW) — COD date
proposal: (no new evidence; keep the round-12 lead: COD between 10 Nov 2023 and 23 May 2024)
note_zh: 沒有新證據。新試的路線：用 EVN 已知的檔名格式（honghoa/files/日月年_CapnhatCODduanNLTTchuyentiep.pdf，含 10112023 與 23524 兩種寫法）探測 2023-11-11 至 2024-05-22 每一天的三種寫法共 540 個網址，沒有一個存在；工貿雜誌 2023-08 與 2025-05 的轉型期專案報導沒有提到 Song An 何時 COD；搜尋業主（IPC／Song An 風電公司）聲明也沒有結果。
note_en: No new evidence. New routes: probing EVN’s known file-name pattern (honghoa/files/<date>_CapnhatCODduanNLTTchuyentiep.pdf, in both the 10112023 and 23524 styles) for every day from 11 Nov 2023 to 22 May 2024, 540 URLs in all, found none; Tạp chí Công Thương’s transitional-project reports of Aug 2023 and May 2025 do not date Song An’s COD; no owner statement (IPC / Song An Wind Power JSC) found.
why: Trackers between Nov 2023 and May 2024 not located.
